Messages.Author: Madman2001
Messages.Body:
In looking over the prospects for a voting Prince deck, was slightly
confused by the finer points of the Archon and Camarilla Exemplary
roles.

Archon says:

"The Archon may enter combat with another vampire as a +1 stealth
action; anyone attempting to block the Archon burns 1 blood"

Now, does this last phrase mean that anyone attempting to block the
Archon during ANY action burns 1 blood, or just if the Archon is
attempting to "rush" another vampire??

Also, I understand that only a Camarilla vampire can be voted an Archon
or a Camarilla Exemplary, true?? However, I also understand that
non-Camarilla vampires can vote on these political actions, true? The
latter frankly makes little sense in terms of the game background,
etc., but is probably necessary in terms of game dynamics.

As always, thanks,
Madman
